name: smwgraphics-boss-pack-part
title: Boss Pack (Part 2)
description:
This is a collection of original reskins drawn by me, GoobieDoobie, for the custom Sprite Ultimate Noob Sprite v1.3.4.3.4 by Iceguy.
The idea for the Design is by autisticsceptile1993, who sent me a list of 10 Characters. I then created these Boss reskins based on that list.

I made 10 reskins, but the file would be too big, so I will upload them in 2 parts, each one containing 5. This one includes:

-Goblin
-Ogre
-Pharaoh
-Spider
-Human Witch

If you want to use all 3 animations of each Boss, look into the ReadMe file, the instructions are under 'How to use'.

Disclaimer!
Human Witch's Animate 3 animation uses almost the whole F-palette!

A credit to me & Iceguy would be appreciated. And also to autisticsceptile1993, without his request, these Characters would've never existed in the first place.
